verdict.line: You lose short trades into her E-stun into Q-reset chain before level 6, and only start winning fights once your Q is maxed and R is online near level 9.

brief.thesis: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anyone caught between the two blades, and a Marked target refreshes her Q (Bladesurge) cooldown on hit — so a landed E turns into a free re-engage that stacks Ionian Fervor attack speed. Aatrox has no answer to that inside a single short exchange; his kit is built to win extended fights via Deathbringer Stance procs and Umbral Dash's on-damage heal, not to win the opening burst. That mismatch is why Irelia holds both the lane and solo-kill edge here (46.8% Aatrox win rate over 1,739 games) even though the champion is roughly a coinflip everywhere else (50% over 77,728 games).

theirWindow.what: Don't stand between her blade paths. If she lands the stun and Mark, her Q refunds and she can chain another dash-strike immediately, stacking Ionian Fervor attack speed — disengage rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Both her E and W are down
yourWindow.what: This is your engage window. Land W (Infernal Chains, range 825) to drag her in, then hold Deathbringer Stance for the empowered auto — it deals magic damage, which her W (Defiant Dance) only reduces for physical damage, so it goes through even if she charges it.

start.why: Highest-performing start in the data (47.4% over 1,294 games, 61.5% pick). The extra AD and healing matter most here since Bladesurge already out-sustains you through minion resets in isolated trades.

boots.why: Overwhelming pick (92.6%, 47.8% WR). Flat physical damage reduction blunts both her auto-attack poke and the bonus on-hit damage she gets once Ionian Fervor is fully stacked.

core.why: First real spike; the shield lets you commit to a trade even if she gets her stun off, and the burst punches through her W damage-reduction window.
On-hit healing extends fights, which is exactly where your Umbral Dash heal and empowered autos out-value her short-trade kit.
Converts burst into a damage-over-time and heals you back, keeping you alive through a Bladesurge-reset chain long enough to win the extended fight.

she's stacking Ionian Fervor and starting to out-trade you on autos
fights are running long and you need armor shred to close them out

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over an extended trade and grants healing on full stacks — it rewards exactly the drawn-out fight you're trying to force, rather than the short burst exchange she wants.

summoners.why: Most-picked and best-performing combo here (71.9% pick, 47.1% WR). Ignite lets you close out a fight before she can Q-reset her way back to safety.

playing.title: Don't trade when her E is up
playing.detail: A landed Flawless Duet stuns and Marks you, refunding her Bladesurge and starting an Ionian Fervor attack-speed stack. Back off and let the cooldown run before you commit.

playing.title: Time Deathbringer Stance into her W charge
playing.detail: Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage while she charges it — your empowered auto deals magic damage, so it bypasses that mitigation entirely.

playing.title: Remember your W is rank 1 until level 14
playing.detail: This skill order maxes Q and E first, so Infernal Chains sits at its 20-second base cooldown from level 3 all the way to level 14. Save it to punish a dash or secure a kill, not as routine poke.

playing.title: Play for level 9, not level 1
playing.detail: Q hits rank 5 (6-second cooldown) around level 9 while her W is still ranking slowly. This is where your sustained-swing damage starts to outpace her short-trade kit.

playing.title: Use World Ender to answer, not open, an all-in
playing.detail: R fears nearby minions and grants AD, extra healing, and move speed. Popping it mid-fight turns her burst attempt into the extended fight your kit wins.

playing.title: Never fight isolated pre-6
playing.detail: Lane and solo-kill advantage both belong to her before your ultimate is online — look to shove and reset rather than force skirmishes.

playing.title: Ignite to deny her Q sustain
playing.detail: Bladesurge heals her on hit; burning her with Ignite during a committed fight removes the healing that lets her recover mid-exchange.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate or sample-size figure above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG. The mechanical reasoning — why those choices work, the trade timing, and the power-curve reads — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out for Irelia’s (P) and Conqueror stacks. Rather than fighting in prolonged fights, aim for small bursts of damage. Avoid her (E) while fighting her.
